info.name: Upload a CSV or Excel file

params.name: sheet_name
params.description: If importing an Excel spreadsheet, the name of the sheet that should be imported.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: [Legacy] The OneSchema id of the workspace to import into. If no workspace id is specified, the default team workspace is used.

params.name: embed_id
params.description: The id of the Embed which the file will be imported into. Omit this to upload into the Workspaces product instead of an Embed.

items.docs:
Upload a CSV (.csv) or Excel (.xlsx) file into OneSchema.
The file should be sent as `multipart/form-data` and include the filename and the file's media type.

If no `embed_id` is provided, the file is uploaded into the Workspaces product. Without a `workspace_id`, it goes into your default team workspace; pass a `workspace_id` to target a specific workspace. Provide `embed_id` only when you want to import the file into a specific Embed instead.
